notes: precedence decides the order of the two machine-level candidate sources in `where`:
steward -> reference (an object the user already had) beats an AIROOT-owned payload
owned   -> an AIROOT-owned payload beats a reference
The default is `steward`, because the steward model is the project's premise: AIROOT is a
hired butler, not a warehouse owner (ADR-0004). It is a file rather than a constant so a
user who deliberately handed a capability to AIROOT can say so explicitly.
A missing or unreadable file falls back to `steward` - never to 'anything goes'.
Bump `revision` whenever this file's meaning changes; commands report it in evidence.
